name: Do I need a car accident attorney if the other driver's insurance company has already offered a settlement?
description: Yes, consult an attorney even with an offer; insurance companies may offer less than your claim is worth, and an attorney can negotiate for fair compensation.

mainEntity.name: Do I need a car accident attorney if the other driver's insurance company has already offered a settlement?

acceptedAnswer.text: It is highly recommended to consult with an attorney even if a settlement offer has been made. Insurance companies often offer a lower amount initially, which may not fully cover your long-term medical expenses, lost wages, or pain and suffering. An attorney can evaluate the offer's fairness, negotiate on your behalf, and ensure you receive appropriate compensation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, consult an attorney even with an offer; insurance companies may offer less than your claim is worth, and an attorney can negotiate for fair compensation.
